title: conioselinum angelicifolium
intro: Conioselinum angelicifolium, commonly known as Angelica, is a flowering plant species in the carrot family (Apiaceae). This plant is known for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects. Its therapeutic actions include reducing fever, relieving pain, and supporting digestion, making it a popular herbal remedy in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of Conioselinum angelicifolium include volatile oils, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
